name: MCIPC8-HDMI
tagline: MCIPC8-HDMI: six COM ports and 4th-13th Gen Intel Core options
description: MCIPC8-HDMI is a fanless industrial PC with six DB9 serial ports, 14 GPIO channels and 9-36 V DC input. Display connections: 2 x HDMI. Memory, USB, LAN speed and storage follow the CPU generation; compare the complete platform details below.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel Core i3 / i5 / i7, 4th-13th Gen

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 4th/5th Gen: 1 x DDR3L SO-DIMM, max. 8 GB; 6th-11th Gen: 2 x DDR4 SO-DIMM (6th-8th Gen: max. 32 GB; 10th/11th Gen: max. 64 GB); 12th/13th Gen: 2 x DDR5 SO-DIMM, max. 64 GB

specs.label: Network
specs.value: 4th-10th Gen: 2 x Intel i210 / i211 / i219 Gigabit LAN; 11th-13th Gen: 2 x Intel I225-V / I226-V 2.5GbE

specs.label: USB
specs.value: 4th/5th Gen: 2 x USB 3.0 + 4 x USB 2.0; 6th-13th Gen: 4 x USB 3.0 + 2 x USB 2.0

specs.label: Serial
specs.value: 6 x DB9 RS-232 COM; 4 support RS-422/485

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: Power, Reset and Clear CMOS buttons; ATX / AT switch; 1 x PS/2

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 1 x mSATA; M.2 2280: SATA / NVMe (6th-10th Gen), only NVMe (11th-13th Gen); 1 x HDD / SSD

specs.label: Wireless
specs.value: 4th-11th Gen: Mini PCIe (half-size); 12th/13th Gen: M.2 2230 (Wi-Fi / Bluetooth)

specs.label: Cellular / SIM
specs.value: 1 x full-size Mini PCIe with SIM slot for 3G / 4G

specs.label: Configuration notes
specs.value: Memory, USB, LAN and storage depend on CPU generation. Images are for reference; final I/O follows the confirmed configuration.

advantageSummary: Match the platform, memory, storage and interfaces to the confirmed configuration.
